decisions.reason: The accelerator program is cheap to carry, feeds the firm's pipeline of green technology options and is still featured on the home page, so its uncertain upside outweighs its low cost.

The CO2-negative bio-bitumen is a far-from-core option whose value has not yet resolved; it costs little to keep on its own web page while market interest is tested, though it is vulnerable once more promising options compete for resources.

The infectious waste decontamination plant is close to the core business, backed by a partnership with ERMAFA and still prominently promoted as the lead WASTX product, which signals the option is moving toward realization rather than failure.
